text: There is a fire on Platform 2 near the exit gate! People are panicking!
Platform par aag lag gayi hai aur log chot kha rahe hain, turant help chahiye
Aag lagvi chhe, dhumo ave chhe, help karo please!
The washroom at GEC station is extremely dirty and smells terrible. Very unhygienic.
Toilet bahut ganda chhe, safai bilkul nahi hoti, badbu aati hai
Station par kacharo pado chhe, safai thati nathi, badbu ave chhe
I was overcharged for my metro token. I paid Rs 40 but the correct fare is Rs 25. I need a refund.
Mujhe ticket me 20 rupaye jyada kaat liye gaye, refund chahiye please
Metro card recharge karvano prayas karo toh machine kaam nathi karti — cannot recharge my card at ATVM
The lift at Riverfront station is stuck between floors. Two people are trapped inside!
Lift kaam nathi karvati, andar fas gaya chhu, madad karo
The escalator at GEC is making loud grinding noises and is very slow. It should be repaired.
The ticket checker was extremely rude to my elderly mother and shouted at her. This is unacceptable.
Guard ne mujhse bahut bura vyavhar kiya aur insult kiya, bahut rude tha
Karmachari no vyavhar bahut kharab chhe, andar ghusi jata rude thashe
The metro was delayed by 25 minutes today. No announcement was made. Very inconvenient.
Bija platform par dhuan avi rayo chhe, koi aag lagi chhe ke? Please check karo
The air conditioning on the train was not working. It was extremely hot and uncomfortable.
Mujhe metro card balance check karna tha par machine kharab thi, kisi ne help nahi ki
There is a suspicious bag left unattended on Platform 1. It has been there for 30 minutes. Please investigate.
